name: jfs
description: Let AI agents use your API keys and passwords without seeing them: commands run with secrets in their environment, output masked, every use approved in the JFSecure app.
long_description: jfs is the MCP server of JFSecure, an offline password and snippet manager. Tools: list_secrets (names only), run_with_secrets (runs a command with a secret's keys as environment variables; every value in the output is masked as [JFSecure: NAME]) and render_template (fills {{Secret:key}} into a file such as .env; the agent only learns which names were filled). There is no tool that returns a value. Every use opens an approval window in the JFSecure desktop app showing the exact command. Requires the JFSecure app (free, Windows / macOS / Linux) running with the vault open: https://secure.jfolio.org/agents

tools.name: list_secrets
tools.description: Names only (never values): secrets, keys and the environment variable each key becomes

tools.name: run_with_secrets
tools.description: Run a command with a secret's keys as environment variables; output comes back with every value masked

tools.name: render_template
tools.description: Write a file (e.g. .env) from a template, filling in {{Secret:key}}; returns only the names filled in
